articleTitle: Point-focusing SH guided-wave EMAT for defect detection in plate
abstract: Metal plates are widely used in industrial production, and defects due to aging, corrosion, and uneven stress distribution may reduce the performance of the corresponding equipment. To detect the presence of defects more accurate, we propose a new point-focusing Shear Horizontal (SH) guided-wave Electromagnetic Acoustic Transducer (EMAT) to detect different types of defects such as the rectangular and cylinder defects. In this work, the rectangular defects with various lengths and widths are investigated, as well as the cylinder defects with different radii. We note that the increase of the defect length will lead to a decrease of the received signal amplitude for the receiving transducer, and the amplitude increases as the defect width increases. For cylinder defects, the radius increases as the amplitude increases in the simulation. The study shows that the proposed focusing EMAT performs excellent capability in detecting plate defects.

articleTitle: A modified ERA-based method for mode identification of low-frequency oscillations in power system
abstract: The stability requirement of the densely interconnected power system indicates the importance of low-frequency oscillation mode identification. Eigensystem Realization Algorithm (ERA) is a time-domain technique for parameter estimation. It is capable of extracting information from multiple-channel input signals even under noisy conditions. However, ERA requires the prior knowledge of the number of modes present in the signal. Therefore, a modified ERA-based mode identification method is proposed in this paper with a new way of order determination. It is demonstrated that the proposed method can obtain an accurate model order estimation at different noise levels. Furthermore, the proposed method is tested on a 36-bus benchmark system as well as on measurement data from a real power system. Comparison of the proposed method with other methods is also carried out. The simulation results confirm the efficacy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on low/high voltage ride through of PV gridconnected system based on control-hardware-in-the-loop
abstract: Fault ride-through capability is one of the important grid-connection indexes for large-scale generation of PV power and other renewable energy, which is of great significance for the safe and stable operation of the grid. In order to improve the fault ride-through capability of PV grid-connected inverter, a comprehensive control strategy of LVRT/HVRT of PV gridconnected inverter based on conventional control scheme is proposed in this paper. Meanwhile, the LVRT/HVRT test platform of PV grid-connected inverter was built by using the simulation technology of RT-LAB hardware-in-the-loop. Firstly, based on the eHS (electric hardware solver) technology of RT-LAB real-time simulation software, a set of PV grid-connected inverter semi-physical simulation system was built, mainly including PV simulator, PV inverter, filter circuit, three-phase controlled voltage source, etc. Then, according to the technical specification of PV grid-connected inverter, the fault ridethrough control strategy of PV grid-connected inverter under the condition of voltage drop/rise symmetrically is proposed. Finally, the simulation tests of LVRT/HVRT were carried out on the simulation platform with the controller of PV inverter. Simulation results show that the proposed control strategy meets the grid-connected requirements during LVRT/HVRT. In addition, it has good dynamic and static characteristics.

articleTitle: A novel individual voltage balancing scheme with reduced voltage sensors for modular multilevel cascade converter-single star bridge cell (MMCC-SSBC) based STATCOM
abstract: Capacitor voltage balancing is indispensable in normal operation for modular multilevel cascade converter-single star bridge cell (MMCC-SSBC) based static synchronous compensator (STATCOM). This paper proposes a novel individual voltage balancing scheme with dramatically reduced voltage sensors. First, zero-sequence voltage injection is enabled to regulate the cluster voltage based on only one voltage sensor in each phase; Then, through the additional inserted hardware units, individual voltage balancing can be achieved. Compared with conventional software voltage balancing method, the proposed balancing scheme has the advantage of simple implementation, lower transportation delay, fast balancing speed, and dramatically reduced voltage sensors. In addition, only some popular power modules are added to balance the individual capacitor voltage. The effectiveness of the proposed individual voltage balancing scheme is verified by simulation results in MMCC-SSBC based STATCOM. With the proposed scheme, the individual voltage balancing and reactive power compensation can be realized simultaneously.

articleTitle: Optimal capacity allocation of advanced adiabatic compressed air energy storage systems considering energy arbitrage
abstract: As the energy scarcity and environment problems become more and more severe, promoting renewable energy has become an important task and thus energy storage draws increasing attention for integrating renewable energy. Among many available options, advanced adiabatic compressed air energy storage (AA-CAES) are considered mature and affordable options for gridscale applications. However, the relatively high capital cost hinders the development of AA-CAES system. As a result, the cost-benefit analysis of AA-CAES application is studied in this paper. The thermodynamic characteristics of AA-CAES system are carefully studied and modeled. An optimal configuration method of AA-CAES capacity considering energy arbitrage is proposed and the optimal capacity of each component of AA-CAES is demonstrated. Simulation results indicate that the application of AA-CAES in arbitrage market is profitable but the payback period is long. The profit estimations are more realistic compare to conventional battery model. Profitable cost range of AA-CAES is found through sensibility analysis. Augmenting electricity price to improve economic of AA-CAES is discussed at the end.
